crossRefs.note: Don’t say, “I will pay back evil.” Wait for Yahweh, and he will save you.
If your enemy is hungry, give him food to eat. If he is thirsty, give him water to drink;
for you will heap coals of fire on his head, and Yahweh will reward you.
But I tell you, don’t resist him who is evil; but whoever strikes you on your right cheek, turn to him the other also.
Repay no one evil for evil. Respect what is honorable in the sight of all men.
See that no one returns evil for evil to anyone, but always follow after that which is good for one another and for all.

Absalom spoke to Amnon neither good nor bad; for Absalom hated Amnon, because he had forced his sister Tamar.

translations.web: Don’t say, “I will do to him as he has done to me; I will repay the man according to his work.”
translations.bsb: Do not say, “I will do to him as he has done to me; I will repay the man according to his work.”
translations.kjv: Say not, I will do so to him as he hath done to me: I will render to the man according to his work.
translations.asv: Say not, I will do so to him as he hath done to me; I will render to the man according to his work.
